predecessors.name: Italian Libya
predecessors.text: the republic's territory, 'from the Nafusa Mountains, near the Tunisian border, to Misrata and the surrounding coast', with the Italian-held Tripoli and Homs areas as the only exceptions

successors.name: Italian Libya
successors.text: the republic's territory, 'from the Nafusa Mountains, near the Tunisian border, to Misrata and the surrounding coast', with the Italian-held Tripoli and Homs areas as the only exceptions

ledger.x: 1918 (16 November): the Tripolitanian Republic is proclaimed.
1918 (16 November): the republic holds the Tripolitanian interior against the Italian-held coast of Tripoli and Homs; Italy 'reasserted control over the colony in the early 1920s'.
1922: the republic is disestablished; 'By 1923, Italian control was effective in the territories of the Republic.'

wars.name: Italian reconquest of Tripolitania
wars.outcome: Italian victory: 'By 1923, Italian control was effective in the territories of the Republic'.

certainty.note: A tribal and urban confederation with no surveyed borders; the page names only the Nafusa Mountains, Misrata, and the Italian-held Tripoli and Homs areas.
